scenarios.notes: A real Secondary press/release at (430,288) opens the 19-entry node menu (menu_open anchor=430,288 entries=19). Eleven Down presses walk 新建子主题 → 新建同级主题 → 剪切 → 复制 → 删除 → 编辑文字 → 新建卡片笔记 → 添加概要 → 添加边界 → 分离为自由主题 → 样式; the disabled 粘贴 row and all separators/sections are skipped. The tall menu flips above the anchor and clamps to the content rect's top 8px edge, covering the in-app menu bar as a native window-level popup. ArrowRight opens the 样式 submenu (menu_submenu_open key=right label=样式).

Escape first closes only the deepest submenu (menu_submenu_close key=escape level=1) and a second Escape closes the whole menu (menu_close reason=escape). A primary click far outside the cards closes it with menu_close reason=outside without activating anything. The 样式 submenu is drawn at the parent row's top edge with a 2px overlap, right of the parent card.

End highlights 聚焦, Enter emits menu_activate key=enter label=聚焦 and the canvas actually enters focus mode: breadcrumb 织思 > 纯 Rust 原生, subtree-only canvas at 128%, status keeps 13 topics with 纯 Rust 原生 selected. The menu itself remains intent-only; the action still travels through panels::context::Action and the existing command path.

The 视图 title menu is an egui Popup hosted by PopupNav. Two Down presses move the highlight from Some(0) to Some(1) over 9 rows (popup_menu key=down highlight=Some(0/1) count=9); the highlighted row uses the accent-soft fill only, with no extra focus ring, and the mouse hover grey remains a separate state.

menu is the 15th golden scenario (ppp 1.5, MW_CONTEXT_DEMO=1, node menu with the 样式 submenu open). It needs --warmup 8 because the popup is still color-fading through frame 6; warmups 6 and 8 are pixel-identical to warmup 60, while warmup 4/5 differ sub-perceptually (max diff 8/3).
